## Travel & Experiences

Travel has given me the opportunity to experience different cultures, places, and perspectives beyond the classroom. I enjoy exploring the history, landscapes, and everyday life of the places I visit.

## Places I've Visited

This page is a collection of some of my travel experiences and photographs. Each place has given me a different perspective and something new to remember.
